notes:
RECOMMENDED NOW FOLLOWS WHAT YOU CAN ACTUALLY SEE. The Recommended row was built from your whole viewing history, including titles you had dismissed from Continue Watching and episodes you had only ticked as watched. So a single show someone removed months ago could still be steering the entire row, with nothing on screen to explain why - one profile was being recommended anime with no anime anywhere in its Continue Watching. Recommended is now based on the titles Continue Watching actually shows, so dismissing something stops it counting. Anything you have already seen is still kept out of the results, dismissed or not.

REMOVING SOMETHING FROM CONTINUE WATCHING NOW REACHES YOUR OTHER DEVICES STRAIGHT AWAY. Two things were in the way. Live updates arriving from another device were being applied to the data but never redrawn on screen, so a removal made on the desktop reached the TV and left the row looking untouched until something else happened to refresh it. And a removal was queued behind the timer meant for playback progress, which waits fifteen seconds. Removals, and marking something watched, now send within about a second, and the other device redraws as soon as they land.

Both devices need this version for the live updates to work in both directions.
